tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po gtan la dbab pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// 'di ni don las mtshan du btags so// de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po gtan la dbab pa zhes 'di ni drang srong gi bka' bzhin spyi bor long zhig bya ba'i bstan bcos don ldan sgrub pa lhur len/ sdug bsngal 'byin pa'i gdul bya'i blo phyin ci ma log par 'chos/ sdug bsngal mtha' dag las skyob/ mdo sde dang mthun par sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// lung gi mdor bstan la thog ma gshis ka med gyur kyang rang ngo shes pa'i tshe tha ma dang ldan pa/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i rtag gnas skabs thams cad du ngo bo mi 'gyur bas chos can ni// thog med sbubs kyi dri ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa'i bsgribs phyir mi mthong ste/ dper na gser gyi gzugs sangs rgyas kyi sku ni sa 'jim gyis bsgribs pa mi mthong ba bzhin/ thog ma med pa'i dus kyi/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyu'i khams ni/ chos kun nyon dang rnam byang*/ rnam kun gyi gnas yin te/ spyi ming du kun gzhi zhes bya ba/ ye shes rnam shes 'dres ma ste/ yang 'byed 'phrul lde las/ sa chu 'dres pa rnyog ma'i dpes gsungs/ de yod pas na 'gro kun dang*// mya ngan 'das pa'ang thob pa yin/ he badzra las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ 'on kyang rang gis rang ma rig pa'i glo bur dri mas bsgribs/ de nyid bsal na sangs rgyas so// mngon pa'i lung don bshad pa de la thog med ces bya ba/ de khams yi sngon na de las ma byung ba'i sangs rgyas sems can gang yang med pa nyid// 'khrul ba'i dus ni yid skad cig 'gyu ba chu rlabs lta bu de nyid de/ gnas gzhan nas zhig brgyud de 'ongs pa min/ de snga ma'i 'khrul pa kha brgyud nas byung ba'o// khams kyi don ni khams sangs rgyas kyi snying po de la yon tan sngar med gsar du byed po med kyang ni// rang mtshan yon tan mi 'gyur bar 'dzin pas de skad brjod/

de rgyu'i don no// chos ni 'khor dang mya ngan 'das// gnyis su snang ba la bshad pa ste// de gnyis kyi bag chags tshogs pa de la ma rig bag chags sa zhes bya// de ni yang dag rtog pa'i yid g.yo ba dang yang dag min/ rtog pa'i yid g.yo ba gnyis 'du byed cing g.yo ba des 'khor 'das so sor bskyed rgyu gnyis kyi yang rgyu yin pas/ rgyu yi rkyen de kun gzhir bshad/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi gnas ni rgyal ba'i snying po ste/ yang dag ma yin kun rtog ni/ dang des bskyed pa'i las nyon sdug bsngal thams cad kyang*/ sems kyi rang bzhin rnam par dag pa la rab tu brten cing gnas kyang de la ma gos dag pa de nyid sems rang bzhin/ sku gsum gyi rang bzhin du bzhugs nas da ltar yod// yod kyang ma rig pa'i kun rtog gis bsgribs nas/ ma mthong phyir na 'khor ba yin// de nyid gzod nas ma grub par shes te bsal na mya ngan 'das/ dri ma ma bral ba'i 'khor ba'i de la tha ma'i tha snyad byas// dus kyi thog mtha' kun rtog gi sgro btags pa nyid la brten// sems nyid rang gis rang ma rig nas sems la nga bdag tu 'dzin pa'i nyon yid 'du byed rlung dang 'dra ba langs pa yis// las dang nyon mongs chu lta bu bsgrubs pa ste// de yi phung po khams skye mched sa lta bu sgrubs bden par med bzhin gnyis snang chos kun ston pa yin// gnyis snang kun brtags de la blang dor byed mkhan 'khrul te/ snang bar ye shes yin pas rang snang dor bas gang du 'gag /ste dor bya med/ rang snang blangs na ci zhig 'byung ste blang byar med/ de bas rang snang la blang dor gnyis 'dzin brdzun pa ma yin nam/ gzung 'dzin gnyis med par de shes pa de yod 'dzin gyi gnyen por gsung mod kyang*/ gzung 'dzin gnyis med snyam pa'i rtog pa de yang bden pa yang yin re rtog pa yin pas so// rmi lam du bu shi rgyu med kyang shi ba rmis nas bu med bsam pa ltar rtog med rtog par gyur pa'i phyir/

sems snang gzugs sogs gcig dur phyi cha phyed nas nam mkha' ltar stong rtog pa/ khyod rang 'khrul pa ma yin nam/ lung las gsungs pa ni/ he badzra las/ bden min brdzun min de bzhin du/ 'on kyang bden zhen dgag phyir gsungs/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po rang gi ngo bo bstan pa ni/ thams cad thams cad chu yi zla ba ltar 'dod pas rnal 'byor mas shes gyis bden min brdzun min te/ chu zla bzhin du gnyis med mkhas rnams 'dod/ cir yang mi rtog pa'i ma bcos tha mal shes pa so so re ba de nyid la/ chos dbyings rgyal ba'i snying po ye shes zer/ ngo bo la 'gyur ba med pas sngar las bzang du sangs rgyas sogs 'phags pas btang ba med/ ngan du sems can gyis ma btang ci ltar sngar bzhin phyin de bzhin/ tha snyad du don 'di ni sa bcu'i byang sems kyis kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pas sangs ma rgyas bar tshig dang ma brjod mod kyang*/ brjod pas de yi don mi shes/ don yongs rdzogs mi shes kyang stan pa'i dgos pa ni sangs rgyas mi thob skam du sems zhum pa dang sems can la brnyas pa dang dri ma bden par 'dzin pa dang yon tan med 'dzin rang lhag snyam pa'i nga rgyal dang ste skyon lnga spong ba'i phyir ro// snang gsal rig bde de yi ma 'gags rol pa las/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi po/ rags pa yin te zhes rgyas phye na de re re yang*/ bye ba phrag rer 'am grangs med/ gsungs pa yin/ grangs bstan pa ni grangs la dga' ba gzhug pa'i ched do// dge ba thar pa'i gnas mi dge ba gnas dang min shes mkhyen pa'i stobs cig pa dang*/ las kyi rnam smin mkhyen stobs rnam smin 'jig rten khams dang gnyis sna tshogs mkhyen stobs gsum dbang po mchog dang mchog min mkhyen stobs bzhi dang*/ sna tshogs mkhyen stobs lnga/ theg gsum thams cad du 'gro ba'i mkhyen stobs drug mos pa mkhyen dang kun 'gro gsum thams cad ba'i// lam dang kun nyon dang rnam byang gi bsam gtan mkhyen stobs bdun lha yi 'chi 'pho dang skye ba mkhyen pa'i stobs brgyad mig sngon gyi gnas rjes dran dang zag pa zhi ba mkhyen pa'i stobs bcu ni/

stobs bcu po de la brten nas mi 'jig pa bzhi/ 'khor dbus su nga ni chos kun byang chub gegs mo zhes dam bca' gcig nyon mong thar pa'i gnyis ston dang*/ theg gsum gsum lam dang 'gog zag pa bzhi ston de ma chos mthun gyi rtsod med nyid/ bag tsha med pa'i rgyu des ma sku mchod rgyug sogs 'khrul ba gsungs ca co med/ thugs la rjed ngad sogs dran pa ma nyams spyod lam rtag tu mnyam gzhag /'khor 'das tha dad 'du shes sna tshogs mi mnga' dang*/ 'dul 'os mi 'os ma brtags btang snyoms med pa spyod pa drug dang*/ chos ston pa'i gdul bya'i don la 'dun pa brtson 'grus bsam mi dgos par dran pa dang*/ chos nyid kyi ting 'dzin ye shes dpag med shes rab zag pa sa bon dang bcas las rnam grol gyi/ rtog pa drug go ye shes mthong ba nyams mi mnga'/ sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las las rnams ye shes sngon 'gro zhing rjes su 'jug pa phrin las gsum dang*/ 'das ma 'ongs da lta'i dus la chags thogs sgrib nyon sgrib shes sgrib med ye shes ma 'dres pa gsum dang bco brgyad de/ so gnyis ldan pa chos sku yin/ da lta de la 'gal bar byed/ yin la yin bzhin ma nges pas/ med phyi don pa la yod rtog gi kun brtag byas/ yul des bskyed pa'i 'jig rten pa'i rnam rtog de gzhan dbang yin/ gzung 'dzin rten des 'gyur med dang phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs su grub pa ma shes pas/ byis pa rang ni 'dam g.yos pas/ byis pa rang nyid bying ba ltar/ rang gis byas pas gzings pa ste/ kye ma chos sku'i yon tan 'di 'gyur med yongs grub ji lta bar yod par bden pa'i shes pa de yang bden shes yin pas phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub yin no// da lta yon tan yod kyang nus pa chung ba de/ yon tan yod pa bden shes bor nas mi bden pa'i gzung 'dzin bzos/ de la rjes 'brang nas 'khrul rtog chu rlabs ltar g.yos pas lan/

da ni sems nyid sangs rgyas yin la yin bzhin du/ shes par gyis la de la gsos nus pa thon la rtogs par gyis dang des chog go /ci ste na sems nyid de la rang gi 'du shes 'khrul pa las 'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ yon tan sngar med gsar du bzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ yang dag pa'i sems nyid rang la rang gis yang dag lta/ yang dag mthong na rnam par grol de bzhin gshegs pa'o// sems nyid dang rnam dbyer bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can/ glo bur dri ma dag gis khams la ma gos pas stong gi /sems nyid dang rnam dbyer med pa'i mtshan nyid can/ bla med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos kyis khams de stong pa min/ de la gzugs sku longs sprul gnyis rang bzhin/ sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan dpe byad/ thob par byed pa'i yon tan rang lus rtsa rlung thig le te/ lus de phya dang dbang phyug dang*/ tshangs dang phyi rol theg dman nyams bden pa'i rdul/ phyi don gyi rnam pa gtod mkhan phag na mo bden pa yis byas pa min gyi sems lus ltar snang ba yin// sgo lnga gzung dang 'dzin pa yi/ rnam 'gyur ma dag des sbyangs pas/ gzugs rdo rje sogs de tshe thob gzugs phung gnas gyur par tha snyad byas/ re sa dang po thob pas kyang dbang lnga gnas 'gyur bas dbang po re re kyang yul lnga lnga la 'jug de bas sbyang bzhi rtsa rlung thig le rnams/ dri ma dag sbyang byas pa dag pa'i gzugs sku ste/ sbyang bya mngal gyi khru ma chos gos nyid/ ma sbyangs ma dag gzugs sku'o ces sogs/ dper na snying po ni shun bcas bai ḍūrya// dag dang nyon mongs dang ldan phyir do kun nas nyon mongs med dag phyir/ rnam par dbye ba med chos phyir/ lhun grub rnam par mi rtogs phyir/ kun pa dang bcas kyang ma 'dres pa/ gang nas kyang ma byung ba'i shun pa dag par byas pa ltar/ nor bu ma thun pa yod med khyad med pa ltar nor bu la rtog pa med pa ltar/ de la yon tan mi snang ste/

yon tan dbyung phyir dang po re ba ba tshwa'i tsub mos chus sbyangs dang*/ bar du skyur po bal gyi la bas sbyangs pa dang*// mtha' mar chu gtsang ka shi kas li ras srab mos sbyangs na/ shun pa dag ste nor bus dgos 'dod 'byung*/ de bzhin sems kyi bai ḍūrya/ ser sna sogs nyon mongs shes bya 'khor gsum du rtog pa snyoms bying rgod 'jug gi /shun pa gsum po sbyang ba'i phyir/ lam bzhi gsum bcu gnyis lam nges 'byed bzhi tshogs sbyor ma dag sa bdun dang*/ dag pa'i sa gsum mtshan 'dzin bzhi la rab sbyangs/ bdag 'dzin rtag 'dzin sogs yang dag ma yin kun rtog de spang bya'i rtog pa/ mi rtag bdag med sogs dag pa'i kun rtog dang gnyen po'i rtog pa sprad pas/ shing gnyis bsrub pas gnyis ka tshig bzhin kun rtog gnyen po spang bya la ston pa'i phyir spang bya zad pa dang gnyen po'i rtogs pa yang spang gnyen gyi rtogs pa ni rmi lam gyi chu rmi lam yin par shes bzhin du brgal ba'i rtsol ba byed pa ltar bral/ mtshan 'dzin bzhi ni spang gnyen gnyis dang de bzhin nyid rtog dang*/ 'bras bu'i mtshan 'dzin bzhi bral ba/ 'bras bu'i mtshan ma yang bral ba de bzhin nyid dmigs kyi sel/ de ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes skye ba dang srid zhi mnyam 'dzin pa tsam mo// sa brgyad pa thob ma thag /yid 'dzin rtog pa bral bas 'bras bu'i mtshan ma tsam 'byung ste de ni sangs rgyas gang gā'i bye snyed kyi zhal bstan nas mi rtog pa las bslang ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang thab kyi snying po sbyang ba la 'jug pa ni 'bras bu'i mtshan ma'o// de tshe spros bral nam mkha'i sku can la/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od zer mtshan gyi me tog gzugs sku gnyis kyi 'gro don rgyas par 'gyur/ ma dag ma dag dag pa dang*/ shin tu rnam dag go rim bzhin/ sems can byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas skabs gsum/

brjod kyang sangs rgyas sngar med gsar skyes min/ ji ltar sngar yod pa bzhin phyis kyang de bzhin/ ngo bo mi 'gyur sangs rgyas snying po yin/ de phyir gnas 'gyur ba dri ma bral tsam de la brjod// gsung rab go nyes kyis gang dag lta ngan sems la zhugs pa rnams/ chos nyid stong nyid las sangs rgyas yon tan 'byung bar 'dod pa ni rgyu gcer bu pa med las skye bar 'dod pa dang khyad med/ kha cig sems nyid la sangs rgyas kyi yon tan sngar med pa yang na rang min phyi rol gyi thos bsam sgom gsum sogs kyi rgyu rkyen gyis bskyed par rtog pa ni/ phyi rol dbang phyug dngos po thams cad des bskyed 'dod pa dang*/ rtag chad 'dod par khyad ci yod// sor rtog ye shes kyis 'jig rten kun la lan drug tu gzigs shing sems can rnams kyi sems rgyud so sor cig car mkhyen pa'i 'du byed skad cig skye 'gag ltar snang*/ ma dag drug yid rnam rtog g.yo ba'i 'du byed dag dang mtshungs/ gal te de ltar ma yin par rgyal ba'i ye shes kyi gdul bya mi mkhyen mi gzigs na gzugs sku'i phrin las rgyun chad 'gyur/ bas mi rigs so// 'on kyang de la 'du byed ming mi brjod/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ming du brjod/ rgyu 'byung ba che las gzugs sgra dri ro reg sogs rang bzhin gang*/ mig sogs 'dzin bcas kyi dri ma dag pa'i tshe rang rang gi ngo bo sngar las kyang nus ldan du gyur pas zhing dag pa ci ltar 'dod bzhin longs spyod kun ston/ te sgyu ma'i ltad mo ba dang sgyu ma mkhan gnyis ka la rta glang snang ba lta bu'o// 'khrul dang ma 'khrul gnyis po yang*/ snang ba'i tsam gyi cha nas khyad par ci yang med/ 'khrul pas ni gzung 'dzin gnyis tha dad du yod cing bden grub tu 'dzin pa yod cing ma 'khrul ba de la de med pa'i khyad par yin rigs pa drug cu pa las dngos po gzugs brnyan lta bu ni/

ye shes min gi rab mthong ba zhes dang rin chen rgyal po las rgyal ba gang dag mya ngan 'das pa kun thams cad chu zla lta bur gzigs pa na zhes gsungs so// gal te de ltar ma yin na/ rgyal ba'i phrin las ji yul gang la tshul ltar 'jug /yid bzhin nor dang dpag bsam shing*/ sogs dpe brjod pa/ ni sangs rgyas la ye shes med pa'i dpe min/ ye shes la mtshan ma'i rtog pa med pa'i nus gzhan don lhun grub tu ston pa la/ bshad kyis gzugs sku gnyis sogs phrin las gzhan rgyud gdul bya'i dag snang kho na min gyi thugs rjes dag snang gnyis ka tshogs dgos/ sangs rgyas la ye shes med cing gzugs sku gnyis gzhan rgyud gdul bya'i dag snang kho na yin na gzhan rgyud ye shes yin par 'gyur/ te ye shes de gzhan rgyud yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na ye shes 'khrul par 'gyur/ te gdul bya'i rgyud 'khrul pa de ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ gal te sangs rgyas la ye shes yod cing de la sems can 'khrul pa snang na rang snang rang gi 'dzin pa yin pas ye shes 'dzin rtog can du 'gyur ro zhes/ 'dod na me long snang ba yang*/ nang du gzugs brnyan me long yang 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog can du 'gyur/ bar mtshungs sems can 'khrul pa ji snyed pa/ rgyal ba'i ye shes yul du snang gyur kyang*/ ye shes 'khrul pas dgos pa med/ dper na mkha' la khyung chen bzhi po rnams/ skye 'gag snang yang nam mkha' la/ gos med cing nam mkha' la skye dang 'gag pa med/ ma dag pa'i tshe na'ang sgo lnga'i shes pa yul la 'bad med 'jug pa ltar de dri bral rgyal ba'i bya sgrub ye shes kyang 'bad med du sems can kun la/ 'jug kyang mkha' la 'byung ba de bzhin gos pa med/ mngon sum rtog bral 'di la 'khrul pa'i ming mi brjod/ bya ba sgrub pa zhes su brjod/ sgrib gsum dag par gyur pa na kun gzhi la gnas pa'i nyon yid nga bdag tu 'dzin pa/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid de zhi ba'ang kyi ye shes su yin kyang*/

zhi mthar mi gnas pa'i byams pa chen po dang snying rje cher ldan pas mdzad pa mos pa ci lta bar/ longs spyod rdzogs sogs de la snang*/ la la sangs rgyas thob pa'i tshe/ yar me shi ba ltar shes rgyun chad nas zhi bar 'dod na theg dman dang mtshungs 'gyur bas de dgag phyir brjod/ ye shes rtag pa gsum yin te/ chos sku rang bzhin rtag pa chos kyi dbyings 'gyur ba med pa'o// longs sku rgyun gyi rtag pa longs spyod rdzogs nges pa lnga ldan pas so// sprul sku rgyun mi 'chad pa rtag pa sprul pa'i sku/ 'khor ba ma stong bar 'byung bas so// de la mi rtag gsum yod de// phyis blo stong par yi byas pa'i stong pa rtag pa min de nyi tshe ba yin pas so// nyon yid dang des bskyed pa'i g.yo ba'i rtog yid rtag pa min/ de 'khrul pa yin pas so// tshogs drug gi shes pa rkyen bzhis 'dus byas pa'i phyir rtag pa min// 'on kyang de'i sbubs la rtag gsum yod// sems can gyi tshe bri ma ye shes 'dres pas so// mi rtag gsum po dri ma ste// rtag pa gsum po ye shes yin/ 'gyur med kyi snying po 'di mu stegs bdag rtag 'dod par 'dod pa dang klu sgrub kyis chos dbyings gang phyir bdag ma yin mtshungs min te// mu stegs pas yid kyis btags dang 'di gzung 'dzin gyi yul min pas yid kyis skyes pa ma yin bud med min ma btaṭa phyir/ gzug dang 'dzin pa rnam grol ba ci ltar bdag gces rtog par bya zhes gsungs so// nyan rang zhi dang mtshungs min te// snying rje chen pos gzugs sku'i yon tan kun ston phyir// sems can lus phung khams dang mtshungs min te// zag bcas las nyon rkyen gyi ma bskyed phyir der ma zad zag med las kyis bsam mi khyab kyi skye ba dang 'chi 'pho yang med/ phyir la ldog par mi 'gyur te// gnas lugs yin la yin par mngon gyur phyir// dri ma ldang ba gtan med de// tha dad kun rtog ma rig pa spangs pas gzung 'dzin bden par bral ba'i phyir/

kyi yon tan thams cad rang chas gnas skabs gsum du 'gyur ba med pa de phyir sems nyid sangs rgyas 'di/ de ltar yod kyang ma dag pa'i tshe ma shes so// gang tshe rtogs pa de yi tshe// ji ltar lcags la tshang ba med pa dang*/ mig la rab rib zhi ba ltar/ ni med pa yin la zhi ba'i mtshan nyid lcags mig la yod pas med par yang mi brjod pa sangs rgyas rnams kyis la 'dod chags sems dang ye shes la/ ma rig pa yod zhi ba ni par mi brjod de de gnyis med pa'i phyir dang med par mi brjod do// de sems dang ye shes ni de gnyis las grol ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi snying po dam pa'i don du skye med phyir// mngon du gyur pa'i tshe sngar med gsar du de nyid du ni grol ba'ang mya ngan las 'das pa med// mkha' 'gyur ba med pa bzhin sangs rgyas de bzhin te// sems can dang sangs rgyas gnyis ni mtshan nyid gcig pas ngo bo gcig tshu rol 'khor ba pha rol myang 'das gnyis su 'dzin pa skye ba med pas/ rang bzhin las gsar du mya ngan 'das pa'ang med/ de phyir skye 'gag gzung 'dzin sogs 'dus byas kyis mngon por stong*// yongs su rdzogs pa ni kun kyang ye shes kho na'i spyod yul yin gyi gzhan bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ phra phyir thos pa'i shes rab kyi yul min la/ don dam phyir na rtog dpyod gyi bsam pas shes rab min// chos nyid zab phyir 'jig rten pa'i/ sgom pa shes rab la sogs yul ma yin/ rang byung sangs rgyas kyi so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ste// rang byung rnam kyi don dam ni/ rang byung dad pa nyid kyis rtog bya yin pas yon tan bskyed/ kye ma rang la yod pa'i tshul 'di ma rtogs pas// byis blo shed ma bye ba'i byis pa rnams 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyams/ phyi'i rkyen thub pa chen po 'i bka' dang de'i dgongs 'grel 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ byams pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi

/mdzad pa'i bstan bcos sogs bstan bcos 'bum phrag du ma gzigs pa'i rgyu ni nang gi sangs rgyas kyi snying po shes rab byams pa snying rje chen po rnams rgyas shing 'phel ba'i mthu yis rang byung rdo rjes bris/ 'gro kun sangs rgyas snying po 'di// mthar phyin ma nor shes par shog /sangs rgyas kyi snying po gtan la dbab pa rdo rje theg pa'i snying po rdzogs so// rdo rje ni 'gyur ba med pa'i sangs rgyas yin la de'i lam du 'gro ba ni theg pa ste rgyal sras rnams der phyin par byed pa'am yang na mi shigs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi snying po ni 'khor 'das thams cad de las mi g.yo ba'i gzhi yin pas rdo rje theg pa'o// rgyud bla ma las/ 'di yi rang bzhin chos sku dang*// de bzhin nyid dang rig kyang ste// zhes gsungs pas chos sku 'bras bu rigs rgyu ngo bo 'gyur ba med pa de nyid do//
